# Mountain Tactical Institute

> > Mission-direct fitness programming for military, law enforcement, and mountain athletes developed by Rob Shaul and team in Jackson, Wyoming.

MTI provides evidence-based training plans and daily programming streams for tactical professionals (SFAS, SWAT, firefighters) and mountain athletes (alpine climbing, Denali expeditions, ultramarathons). The institute offers 450+ specialized programs through their Athlete Subscription service and operates a strength lab testing facility.

## Key Topics

- Mountain Tactical Institute (MTI)

## Exercise Reference

- [Kneeling Founder - Mountain Tactical Institute](https://mtntactical.com/exercises/2020-kneeling-founder): Kneeling Founder exercise: hip hinge hold with two arm positions
- [Standing Founder - Mountain Tactical Institute](https://mtntactical.com/exercises/standing-founder-2020): Standing Founder: isometric posterior chain hold with timed positions
- [DOT Drill - Mountain Tactical Institute](https://mtntactical.com/exercises/mnt113-dot-drill): DOT Drill: 5-sequence agility pattern for footwork and coordination
- [Prone to 40ft Sprint - Mountain Tactical Institute](https://mtntactical.com/exercises/prone-40ft-sprint): Prone to 40ft Sprint: explosive pop-up drill for agility training
